comment:
* This is the UDP Message handler that gets created when a UDP message needs to * be processed. The message is processed by creating a String Message parser * and invoking it on the message read from the UDP socket. The parsed structure * is handed off via a SIP stack request for further processing. This stack * structure isolates the message handling logic from the mechanics of sending * and recieving messages (which could be either udp or tcp. * * * @author M. Ranganathan
* * * * @version 1.2 $Revision: 1.66 $ $Date: 2010/01/14 05:15:49 $

variables.name: sipStack
variables.comment: * SIP Stack structure for this channel.

variables.name: myParser
variables.comment: * The parser we are using for messages received from this channel.

variables.name: peerAddress
variables.comment: * Where we got the stuff from

variables.name: peerPort
variables.comment: * Reciever port -- port of the destination.

variables.name: peerProtocol
variables.comment: * Protocol to use when talking to receiver (i.e. when sending replies).

variables.name: pingBackRecord
variables.comment:
* A table that keeps track of when the last pingback was sent to a given remote IP address
     * and port. This is for NAT compensation. This stays in the table for 1 seconds and prevents 
     * infinite loop. If a second pingback happens in that period of time, it will be dropped.

methods.name: private void processIncomingDataPacket(DatagramPacket packet) throws Exception
methods.comment:
* Process an incoming datagram
     *
     * @param packet
     *            is the incoming datagram packet.

methods.name: public void processMessage(SIPMessage sipMessage)
methods.comment:
* Actually proces the parsed message.
     *
     * @param sipMessage

methods.name: public void handleException(ParseException ex, SIPMessage sipMessage, Class hdrClass, String header, String message) throws ParseException
methods.comment:
* Implementation of the ParseExceptionListener interface.
     *
     * @param ex
     *            Exception that is given to us by the parser.
     * @throws ParseException
     *             If we choose to reject the header or message.

methods.name: public void sendMessage(SIPMessage sipMessage) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Return a reply from a pre-constructed reply. This sends the message back
     * to the entity who caused us to create this channel in the first place.
     *
     * @param sipMessage
     *            Message string to send.
     * @throws IOException
     *             If there is a problem with sending the message.

methods.name: protected void sendMessage(byte[] msg, InetAddress peerAddress, int peerPort, boolean reConnect) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Send a message to a specified receiver address.
     *
     * @param msg
     *            string to send.
     * @param peerAddress
     *            Address of the place to send it to.
     * @param peerPort
     *            the port to send it to.
     * @throws IOException
     *             If there is trouble sending this message.

methods.name: protected void sendMessage(byte[] msg, InetAddress peerAddress, int peerPort, String peerProtocol, boolean retry) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Send a message to a specified receiver address.
     *
     * @param msg
     *            message string to send.
     * @param peerAddress
     *            Address of the place to send it to.
     * @param peerPort
     *            the port to send it to.
     * @param peerProtocol
     *            protocol to use to send.
     * @throws IOException
     *             If there is trouble sending this message.

methods.name: public SIPTransactionStack getSIPStack()
methods.comment:
* get the stack pointer.
     *
     * @return The sip stack for this channel.

methods.name: public String getTransport()
methods.comment:
* Return a transport string.
     *
     * @return the string "udp" in this case.

methods.name: public String getHost()
methods.comment:
* get the stack address for the stack that received this message.
     *
     * @return The stack address for our sipStack.

methods.name: public int getPort()
methods.comment:
* get the port.
     *
     * @return Our port (on which we are getting datagram packets).

methods.name: public String getPeerName()
methods.comment:
* get the name (address) of the host that sent me the message
     *
     * @return The name of the sender (from the datagram packet).

methods.name: public String getPeerAddress()
methods.comment:
* get the address of the host that sent me the message
     *
     * @return The senders ip address.

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object other)
methods.comment:
* Compare two UDP Message channels for equality.
     *
     * @param other
     *            The other message channel with which to compare oursleves.

methods.name: public String getViaHost()
methods.comment:
* Get the logical originator of the message (from the top via header).
     *
     * @return topmost via header sentby field

methods.name: public int getViaPort()
methods.comment:
* Get the logical port of the message orginator (from the top via hdr).
     *
     * @return the via port from the topmost via header.

methods.name: public boolean isReliable()
methods.comment: * Returns "false" as this is an unreliable transport.

methods.name: public boolean isSecure()
methods.comment: * UDP is not a secure protocol.
